key_insight: ScaleWorld uses one shared video model to predict a low-resolution world and refine its own predictions into high-resolution video, eliminating the need for a separate refinement model.
problem_solved: Directly generating high-resolution world videos requires substantial computation and memory, making detailed scene generation expensive.
method: Use a causal video model to predict low-resolution world videos.
Refine those predictions into high-resolution outputs with finer scene structures and textures.
Share a single backbone across prediction and refinement rather than using separate models.
impact: For practitioners building video world models, ScaleWorld offers a unified approach to detailed video generation without maintaining a separate refiner. The provided abstract is truncated, so quantitative efficiency and quality gains cannot be assessed.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: low-resolution prediction → refinement → high-resolution video, enclosed within one shared backbone.
Magnified scene crops illustrating coarse structures versus fine textures.
Architecture comparison showing separate prediction/refinement models versus ScaleWorld’s shared model.
Compute and memory icons highlighting the cost challenge of direct high-resolution generation.
paper_title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
paper_authors: Yansong Qu, Wesker Zheng, Quanjian Song, Zhiyuan Zhang, Xiao Cao
